name: Homepage renders through ngrok tunnel
description: A visitor opens the JobSearch homepage through an ngrok public URL, passes the ngrok browser warning if it appears, and verifies the main homepage sections.

planSteps.description: If an ngrok browser warning page appears, click the button or link to continue to the site
Verify the JobSearch homepage is loaded and the JobSearch brand is visible
Verify a job search form with city and employment type fields is visible
Verify the page has controls for job seeker and employer modes
Scroll down through the homepage content
Verify the homepage shows company, popular, vacancy, or footer content below the hero area
